about: Modwerk source-only loop-sync package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/loop-sync.

mods.title: Loop Sync
mods.summary: Keeps sample loops in time with the project tempo by repitching them; AUTO reads each loop's tempo from its length, locks and scenes included.
mods.description: Keeps sample loops in time with the project tempo by repitching them; AUTO reads each loop's tempo from its length, locks and scenes included.

mods.on_unit: Earlier builds tested by the author on an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 by ear; this package has not run on a unit.
